_doc: Behavioral capability-axis corpus. Each case pins ONE loop-discipline property and is scored DETERMINISTICALLY off the run transcript + resulting filesystem (no LLM in the scoring path). setup.files seed the temp cwd. assert keys: max_steps, tool_invoked[], tool_not_invoked[], reply_contains[], reply_contains_any[], reply_not_contains[], file_exists[], file_absent[], file_contains{path:substr}. Add cases freely.
